Monstrous Humanoid · SM +0 Scorpionfolk [Monster Manual II, page 221]

A humanoid torso rising from the body of a great scorpion, with a pincer arm, a raised sting and a pike carried in the free hands. They hold desert country as their own, hate anything that settles in it, and are strong enough to make that stick.

PincerPincer (14): thrust 1d+2 cutting (KYOS: 2d-1 cutting), Reach C-1. The scorpionfolk can either nip and let go or hold on and grapple the victim in addition to injuring him.
